answer: The vertex schedule is applied in shale and nectar makes public each instalment. An copycat thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1083 identities would post 3879 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
